# Contributing

This template is copied into downstream projects when they do not have their own contribution guide. In this kit repository, the root `CONTRIBUTING.md` is the source of truth.

## Workflow

1. Open an issue or describe the intended change.
2. Keep changes scoped and easy to review.
3. Add or update tests when behavior changes.
4. Run the relevant validation before opening a pull request.

## Pull Request Checklist

- [ ] The change has a clear purpose.
- [ ] Unrelated formatting or refactors are avoided.
- [ ] Secrets and local files are not included.
- [ ] Documentation is updated when workflows change.
